hosts.prompt: A continuous wide shot of a stone suspension bridge over a misty river at dawn. A small white ferry moves slowly beneath the bridge while the camera stays on the river bank.
A fixed overhead shot of orange and white koi fish circling in a clear garden pond, with ripples crossing reflections of green leaves.
A continuous street level shot of a cyclist in a blue jacket riding past a curved glass building on an overcast day. The camera slowly pans to follow the cyclist.
A continuous wide shot of two giraffes walking across dry golden grass in a savanna. Scattered acacia trees sway gently while the camera remains still.
